_about: NOAA NCEI Significant Volcanic Eruptions Database (doi:10.7289/V5JW8BSH): eruptions with deaths, $1M+ damage, VEI 6+, or a tsunami or earthquake. magnitude: VEI. Times UTC. Dates before 1582-10-15 are taken as Julian (as historical catalogues record them); a day without a time is cast at local noon, tz_east being the place's mean time.
